subject: Fenerbahce come back twice to beat Liverpool 3-2 in the Champions League
title: Liverpool led twice, lost in Istanbul

lines.vo: Liverpool led twice in Istanbul. They still lost.

lines.vo: They arrived with a perfect start, including four-three against Villarreal. Not a calm perfect.
lines.footage: Liverpool Champions League highlights, Villarreal game

lines.vo: Nyoni and Isak scored for Liverpool, and Liverpool led twice.

lines.vo: Fenerbahce came back both times. Greenwood, Archie Brown and Vedat Muriqi scored.

lines.vo: Muriqi came off the bench and scored. A very productive bench.
Three-two. Fenerbahce's first points of the competition.
So, Liverpool's perfect start? Perfect until Istanbul.
